name: PI Workflow Status
description: See which Pi workflow and stage every agent in Orca is in: an Activity list of all agents with workflow chips, and the selected agent's pipeline with done, current and pending stages.

cover.alt: PI Workflow Status: an Activity list of agents with workflow chips above the pipeline of the selected agent, in a light and a dark theme

screenshots.alt: Two panels in the light theme: one shows a Coding workflow in its implement stage, the other a Package workflow in verify with a nested ResultCheck
screenshots.caption: Every agent with its workflow, and the selected pipeline stage by stage

screenshots.alt: The same two panels in the dark theme
screenshots.caption: Light and dark themes

settings.title: Pi sessions folder
settings.description: Folder in which Pi stores its session files. ~ stands for your home folder.

settings.title: Remote Orca servers
settings.description: Paired Orca servers whose jobs to show, as names or ids separated by commas. Empty asks every saved server. The plugin must be loaded as a development folder on each server.
